title: Host settings
description: One installation's own defaults (<host-config>/settings.json, docs/host-config.md "Host settings"). Every key is optional; an absent key keeps the neutral default, which names no installation.

projectsRoot.description: The directory whose <name>-project entries are the projects. DEVPANEL_PROJECTS_DIR still wins; without either it is the directory holding the panel's own checkout.

dataRoot.description: Where the panel keeps what it writes: the issue root is <dataRoot>/issues (issues, runs, their worktrees, private Git directories and scratch, supervisor state) the server log <dataRoot>/logs, the operator token <dataRoot>/.devpanel-token and the TLS certificate <dataRoot>/cert. DEVPANEL_ISSUES_DIR, DEVPANEL_LOG_DIR, DEVPANEL_TOKEN_FILE and DEVPANEL_CERT_DIR still win; without either it is the panel checkout. `~/` is the home of the account running the panel.

gitStore.description: Keep what the engine writes into Git — snapshot objects, refs/devpanel/*, the candidate branches devpanel/<issue>/<run> — in a store of the panel's own, <dataRoot>/repos/<project>.git, which reads the project's objects through alternates (runtime/git-store.mjs). The project repository is then only read, and fetched into for an operator-approved merge. Needs dataRoot; default false: the project repository is the store.

nestedRepositories.description: What a working-tree snapshot takes of a repository nested in the project's checkout (a monorepo's parts). `gitlink` (default): what `git add -A` records, the nested repository's HEAD commit id and no content, so its directory is empty in the run's worktree. `include`: what that repository would carry (tracked and untracked, unignored files, as they are on disk; never its .git), so the run sees the whole tree; apply-to-source writes changes there in place, and a commit delivery that touches one is refused. runtime/working-tree.mjs includeNested.

projectDiscovery.description: Find projects below the projects root instead of taking its <name>-project entries (project-path.mjs discoveredProjects). A matching directory is a project when it holds one of the markers; its identity is its relative path joined with '-', plus '-project'.

pattern.description: Relative path segments under the projects root, `*` matching within one segment: "*/*" is every directory two levels down.

markers.description: File names any one of which makes a matching directory a project. Default ["package.json"].

proxyLogin.description: The reverse proxy's HTTP basic-auth login (server/proxy-user.mjs).

usersDir.description: Where the proxy publishes its users' credential files, <usersDir>/<user>/<file>; `{hostname}` is replaced by this host's name. DEVPANEL_USERS_DIR still wins. Without one, a login name is used as the actor but never verified.

digestFiles.description: Names of the files in a user's directory that hold a SHA-512 hex digest; any one admits. Default [".hash"].

headerMarkers.description: Words read as script header markers (`# <MARKER> key: value`) besides DEVPANEL, which is always read.

confinement.description: The unit user and home of `kind: candidate` commands when a project's testDrive.confinement does not name them.

forbiddenPrefixes.description: Entries of the projects root named <prefix>.<anything> are container filesystems no run may read (runtime/selection.mjs forbiddenRoots). Replaces the default ["production", "staging"].

allowedHomePaths.description: Directories inside the home that are not forbidden for being in it: an allowed root or materialized target within one passes the home rule (every other forbidden root still applies, and one that contains the home is still refused). `~/` is the home of the account running the panel. Default none: the whole home is forbidden, because it holds the operator's keys and CLI logins.

disabled.description: Runtimes this installation does not have. Their roster entries are left out of the configuration, so no playbook seat, supervisor or fallback can use them; a playbook that names one fails resolution saying so (override it in host-config/playbooks/).

readOnly.description: Directories bound read-only into every seat fence besides the system ones, for a toolchain installed under the home (`~/.nvm`). The home itself, a directory containing it, and the CLI credential directories are refused; the fence proof covers each like any other read-only grant.

nodeModules.description: Seat tooling for every project that declares none in projects/<id>.yaml: each node_modules directory beside a package.json in the project's checkout (the root and up to three levels below) is mounted read-only at the same place in the worktree, with its build caches masked (each an empty writable directory in the fence), and the package.json `test` and `lint` scripts become declared commands (`npm run <script>`, offline). A node_modules that is a symlink, lies outside the checkout or fails the declared-mount checks is left out and reported. Resolved into each run's snapshot (runtime/node-modules-tooling.mjs).

linkBaseVariable.description: An environment variable the devpanel skill client reads as its link base when DEVPANEL_LINKBASE is unset (an editor terminal that exports one under its own name).

panelUrl.description: The panel's private address that tools/provision-reporter.mjs gives a deployment when --url is not passed.

seatGuidance.description: Installation notes given to run seats (runtime/host-guidance.mjs): CLAUDE.local.md and <host-config>/docs/, frozen into the run's evidence at start. Nothing is exposed without it.
